title: Isaac Liem · Essays
subtitle: Long-form writing on protocols, privacy, audit, and infrastructure. By Isaac Liem.

posts.title: The Closer Protocol
posts.description: An agent can finish a computation and leave the actual question unresolved. Closer Protocol is a proposed answer: obligations that survive agent episodes, evidence that has to earn its conclusions, and authority that cannot be inferred from a goal. A review draft, published here so it has a stable address.

posts.title: The Meter: Spread is Signal
posts.description: Ask a model the same question five times and it will either answer five ways or one way. The variance of a model's unaided attempts predicts whether new true information will move its score — a meter you can read before you spend a token.

posts.title: The Exchange of Thinking Work
posts.description: An agent that cannot pay for itself is a toy. Three citizens, one loop, and an experiment to claw back what the subscription costs.
